title: A negative counter, a cache breakdown without its total, and a space after "usage":
matrix: input, output, cache-read and cache-write breakdowns
policy: P8: a negative or non-numeric counter is invalid and never subtracts; a cache-write breakdown is used when the flat total is absent; valid JSON is read whatever its whitespace.
derivation: msg_10a [100, 50] with cache read -1000 -> [100, 50, 0, 0, 0]. msg_10c [10, 1] with 5m 200 and 1h 100 and no cache_creation_input_tokens -> 5m 200, 1h 100. msg_10d [30, 3] written as "usage": { -> counted. Expected [140, 54, 200, 100, 0, 3] = 494. Today: the -1000 is added, the breakdown is dropped (0 != 300) and msg_10d is skipped by the byte pre-filter: [110, 51, 0, 0, -1000, 2] = -839.
